parameters.content:
## Workflow 4 — Quality Verification (v2)

Runs daily at 06:00 to verify ChromaDB has sufficient content for all exams.

**Thresholds:**
- < 50 chunks = BELOW_THRESHOLD alert
- 0 chunks = EMPTY alert (will use hardcoded fallback)

**Changes from v1:**
- FIX: Auto re-index now targets only failing exams (was 'all' before)
- FIX: Added result check after re-index (was missing before)
- FIX: Added retry logic on all HTTP nodes
- Added splitInBatches loop for per-exam targeted re-index

**On alert flow:**
1. Log warning to n8n console
2. POST to FastAPI /admin/content-alert (saved to data/alerts.json)
3. Extract only failing exams
4. Re-index each failing exam one at a time
5. Check and log result per exam

**Backend must be running at:** http://localhost:8003
